fields.description: Users holding this role are capped at the size below. A user with several capped roles gets the most permissive of them, so staff roles are never narrowed by also being a Student.
fields.label: Role

fields.description: Maximum upload size in MB for this role. Must not exceed System Settings → Max File Size, which Frappe enforces first and which should be set to the most permissive role's value.
fields.label: Max File Size (MB)
